title: Shedeur Sanders took first-team reps in Todd Monken's first Browns practice — but he wasn't the only one

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Shedeur Sanders took first-team reps in Todd Monken's first Browns practice — but he wasn't the only one
sources.description: Monken said the distribution of first-team snaps will change throughout this week's three-day voluntary minicamp. He pushed back on the characterization that Sanders and Deshaun Watson are the two candidates with a chance to start.
